direction: Vivid full-colour gift cover: Alex enthusiastically explains his run at a café table as Sam tries to have a normal conversation. Editorial ink identity from locked references; title dominates at thumbnail size. No logos, app screens or lettering in generated art. Deep blue wrap, vivid coral and yellow accents; spine remains unlettered at 80 pages.
author: Kieran Smith
back_copy:
They only asked how your weekend was.

You explained the porridge, the weather, the headwind and why the final average was misleading.

The Normal Conversation Rehabilitation Service has prepared this manual for runners whose training now occupies meals, holidays and the first twelve minutes of any conversation.

Includes diagnostic tests, conversation exercises and a certificate of conditional discharge.

Give it to the runner who already knows who they are.
